:::{#welcome}

::: {.justify}

Welcome! I am a PhD researcher at the School of Politics and International Relations, University College Dublin. My research interests lie at the intersection of **political communication**, **EU politics**, and **computational social science**. 

My PhD project analyses **strategic crisis communication** in EU institutions during crises, using **NLP** and **quantitative methods**, such as **machine learning** and **large language models**, to analyse textual data and understand what drives this type of communication.   

I am also a contributor and research assistant on the [Irish Polling Indicator](https://pollingindicator.com/) project, and a co-creator of the [Irish Demographic Polling Data](https://github.com/Irish-Dem-Polling/datasets) and the [Irish Local and European Elections Manifestos](https://github.com/stefan-mueller/iemanifestos).

Feel free to [reach out](mailto:paula.montano1@gmail.com) to explore collaboration opportunities or to share PhD journey experiences. Check more about my [research](research.qmd), [teaching](teaching.qmd) and [CV](CV_Montano_Paula.pdf).
